cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Name My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get them to acknowledge exactly what your effort, sacrifice, or strategy added to the result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. When you thank the festival team, mention who repaired the stage in the rain.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll thank everyone equally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Wonderful. Which equal sentence includes my waterproof trousers?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You want your name in the speech?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Beside the part that kept the dancers above ground.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My new teacher told me to stop mixing everything with black.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She made me throw out your paint set.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You used to be far too sentimental. I was beginning to worry I'd never get you past that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When you thank the festival team, mention who repaired the stage in the rain.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll thank everyone equally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Which equal sentence includes my waterproof trousers?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You want your name in the speech?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Beside the part that kept the dancers above ground.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please say what my spreadsheet added to the successful trip.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It helped enormously.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: With what?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Keeping track of the bookings.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Add 'all thirty missing bookings' and I'll recognise the achievement.

cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Pick the Prize
cards.instruction: Make them choose which reward, principle, or relationship matters most when not everything can be kept.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Choose the trophy ceremony or our anniversary dinner. They're at the same time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we celebrate afterwards?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then you're choosing the trophy and postponing us. Say which.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It could be a short ceremony.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you leave before your name is called? That's the choice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My new teacher told me to stop mixing everything with black.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She made me throw out your paint set.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You used to be far too sentimental. I was beginning to worry I'd never get you past that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Choose the trophy ceremony or our anniversary dinner. They're at the same time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we celebrate afterwards?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you're choosing the trophy and postponing us. Say which.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It could be a short ceremony.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you leave before your name is called? That's the choice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can keep the prize money or fund the team trip. Which matters more?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't we do a cheaper trip?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if someone adds money. You hold the prize.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're making me look selfish.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm asking you to choose before everyone else quietly pays for it.

cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Lose Something for Me
cards.instruction: Create a loyalty test by asking them to accept a real disadvantage on your behalf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Will you give me your first turn, even if it costs you the match?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why would I do that?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. You said you were on my side. This side has a cost.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant emotionally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then lend the emotion a turn so I can see it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My new teacher told me to stop mixing everything with black.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She made me throw out your paint set.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You used to be far too sentimental. I was beginning to worry I'd never get you past that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you give me your first turn, even if it costs you the match?

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said you were on my side. This side has a cost.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant emotionally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then lend the emotion a turn so I can see it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Miss the prize ceremony and come to my tiny opening night.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm receiving the prize.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know. Coming wouldn't mean much if you had nothing else to do.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's an unfair test.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Maybe. I'm trying to discover whether I'm more than the convenient option.

cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Concede the Point
cards.instruction: Get them to release one claim, advantage, or disputed victory without reopening the entire contest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Concede that one ball was out. You can keep the match.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then why does it matter?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I'd like one corner of reality returned to me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're not demanding a rematch?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. Just say 'out' without attaching your trophy to it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My new teacher told me to stop mixing everything with black.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She made me throw out your paint set.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You used to be far too sentimental. I was beginning to worry I'd never get you past that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Concede that one ball was out. You can keep the match.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then why does it matter?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like one corner of reality returned to me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're not demanding a rematch?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. Just say 'out' without attaching your trophy to it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Admit I found the restaurant. You can keep credit for the whole holiday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You also complained about the menu.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Different claim. I'm not filing it today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. You found it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. The rest of your glorious itinerary remains untouched.

cards.title: I Changed the Odds
cards.instruction: Hide how your own choice tilted the contest, bargain, or consequence while continuing to judge the outcome.
